Wind carries tiny droplets already present in fog; mesh captures some of them, and the water drains through a gutter into a clean container. This guide shows how to choose a site, build a trial setup, measure the yield, and avoid assuming the collected water is safe to drink.","materials":["Clean, strong open-mesh netting (about 1 m² for a trial)","Two sturdy poles and guy lines","Clean gutter or narrow runoff channel","Short food-safe hose or tube","Clean lidded container","A reliable way to filter debris and disinfect water"],"verify":"A working collector catches droplets on the mesh and directs them through a gutter into a clean container. Measure yields across several fog events rather than judging by the wetness of the mesh. Collected water still needs a safety assessment and suitable treatment.","mistake":"Common errors: placing the net parallel instead of across the fog-bearing wind; using a solid sheet instead of open mesh; leaving the gutter level; counting rainwater as fog yield; and assuming clear collected water is safe to drink.","safety":"Fog collection supplements other water sources; it is effective only under suitable local conditions. Avoid cliffs, storms, and strong gusts. Water may contain microbes and pollutants from air or equipment. Disinfection does not remove hazardous chemicals: do not drink fog water if industrial emissions or pesticide contamination are suspected.","alternate":"For a small field experiment, stretch clean mesh between trekking poles. Do not rely on a high yield: a small surface or unsuitable fabric usually collects very little water.","comparison":[["Conditions","Expected result","What to do"],["Frequent dense fog and steady airflow","Best conditions for collection","Face the mesh across the wind and measure over multiple fog events"],["Fog but little wind","Droplets may collect very slowly","Try a test mesh; do not count on rapid water supplies"],["Hot dry day, no fog","Almost nothing to collect","Find another water source"],["Dust, industrial emissions, pesticides","Possible toxic contamination","Do not use collected water for drinking"]],"steps":[{"title":"Find where wind carries fog","body":"Choose an open, safe place where fog regularly moves through a coastal ridge, mountain saddle, or slope. Observe at different times: you need actual fog droplets moving through the site, not just humid morning air. Stay clear of cliffs, storm-exposed summits, roads, and polluted areas.","check":"Watch the direction of fog and grass movement. With still or short-lived fog, yield may be negligible."},{"title":"Prepare mesh, poles, gutter, and a clean container","body":"For a trial, use roughly 1 m² of strong, clean, open-mesh material, two poles, rope, a small gutter, and a lidded container. The mesh intercepts droplets while allowing air through. Solid plastic sheeting is not a substitute; very dense cloth may also perform poorly. Never use materials previously exposed to chemicals.","check":"Check that the net has no solvent odor and the gutter is clean and free of sharp, rusty edges."},{"title":"Mount the mesh vertically across the fog-bearing wind","body":"Stretch the mesh between two poles so that its surface is roughly perpendicular to the prevailing wind that carries the fog. Secure the edges and brace the poles with guy lines. Keep the bottom above a clean gutter and off the ground. Never put a collector where a gust could topple it onto people.","check":"From the windward side you should see the broad face of the net, not its narrow edge. Poles must be stable."},{"title":"Fit a sloped gutter and lead water to the container","body":"Fix a clean gutter along the lower edge of the net with a slight slope to one side. Lead a short food-safe tube from the outlet into a capped bottle or canister. Drops should run down the net into the gutter, not along dirty ropes or poles. Keep leaves and insects out of the receiver.","check":"Pour a small amount of clean water onto the top of the net as a test; it should reach the container without pooling near the supports."},{"title":"Confirm the collected drops really come from fog","body":"During fog, look for tiny drops settling on the fibers, merging, and running downward. At first the mesh absorbs or holds some water, so visible runoff may take time. If it rains, the container will also receive rainwater: do not count that volume as fog collection.","check":"Water should reach the gutter during fog. A wet mesh alone is not proof of a useful yield."},{"title":"Try a small improvised collector on a hike","body":"If you have no large mesh, stretch a small clean net between trekking poles or branches and guide the lower edge toward a cup. This is only a trial. Small area and imperfect fabric often yield very little; do not spend your remaining energy or drinking water on it.","check":"Keep the net off the soil and the cup stable. If repeated fog events produce almost nothing, seek another source."},{"title":"Measure yield and maintain the net","body":"Collect the runoff in a graduated container. Record the volume, time, fog conditions, and wind direction over several fog episodes. After strong wind, tighten supports. Remove leaves, dust, algae, and droppings from the net, gutter, and tube. Actual production varies greatly with terrain, season, fog, and wind.","check":"Mesh is intact, the gutter drains freely, and water does not stagnate in the tube."},{"title":"Assess quality and treat collected water","body":"Fog water may contain microbes, dust, sea salt, and contaminants from air or equipment. Transfer it to a clean container, remove visible debris, and use a suitable disinfection method. If industrial emissions, pesticides, or other toxic chemicals are suspected, do not use it for drinking. Boiling does not remove such chemicals.","check":"Keep raw and drinking water in separate, clearly marked containers. Clear appearance does not prove safety."}]}},"diagramLabels":{"fogFlow":"Fog-bearing wind","mesh":"Mesh","droplets":"Droplets","gutter":"Gutter","container":"Container","good":"Works better","poor":"Works poorly","wind":"Fog + wind","dry":"No fog","clean":"Check water safety"}},"pl":{"ui":{"languageTitle":"Języki aplikacji","languageSubtitle":"Dokładnie 75 języków zaplanowanych na wydanie międzynarodowe. Unikaj urwisk, burz i silnych podmuchów. Woda może zawierać drobnoustroje i zanieczyszczenia z powietrza lub sprzętu. Dezynfekcja nie usuwa niebezpiecznych chemikaliów — nie pij zebranej wody, jeśli podejrzewasz emisje przemysłowe lub pestycydy.","alternate":"Na krótką próbę można rozpiąć czystą siatkę między kijkami trekkingowymi. Nie oczekuj dużej ilości: mała powierzchnia i niewłaściwy materiał zazwyczaj zbierają bardzo mało wody.","comparison":[["Warunki","Czego oczekiwać","Co zrobić"],["Częsta gęsta mgła i stały ruch powietrza","Najlepsze warunki zbioru","Ustaw siatkę poprzecznie do wiatru i mierz przez kilka epizodów mgły"],["Mgła bez wyraźnego wiatru","Krople mogą osadzać się bardzo wolno","Sprawdź na próbnej siatce; nie licz na szybki zapas"],["Gorący suchy dzień bez mgły","Prawie nic do zebrania","Poszukaj innego źródła wody"],["Pył, emisje przemysłowe, pestycydy","Ryzyko toksycznych zanieczyszczeń","Nie używaj zebranej wody do picia"]],"steps":[{"title":"Znajdź miejsce, przez które wiatr niesie mgłę","body":"Wybierz otwartą i bezpieczną przestrzeń, gdzie mgła często przepływa wzdłuż wybrzeża, przez przełęcz lub zbocze. Obserwuj miejsce o różnych porach: potrzebne są rzeczywiste kropelki mgły przenoszone przez wiatr, a nie tylko wilgotne poranne powietrze. Unikaj urwisk, burzowych szczytów, dróg i zanieczyszczonych obszarów.","check":"Sprawdź kierunek przesuwania mgły i ruchu traw. Gdy mgła stoi lub szybko zanika, zbiór może być znikomy."},{"title":"Przygotuj siatkę, podpory, rynnę i czysty pojemnik","body":"Do próby wystarczy około 1 m² mocnej, czystej siatki o otwartych oczkach, dwa słupki, linka, mała rynna i pojemnik z pokrywką. Siatka zatrzymuje kropelki, ale przepuszcza powietrze. Jednolita folia jej nie zastępuje, a zbyt gęsta tkanina także może działać gorzej. Nie używaj materiałów po chemikaliach.","check":"Sprawdź, czy siatka nie pachnie rozpuszczalnikami, a rynna jest czysta, bez rdzy i ostrych krawędzi."},{"title":"Ustaw siatkę pionowo, poprzecznie do wiatru","body":"Rozepnij siatkę między dwoma słupkami tak, aby jej płaszczyzna była w przybliżeniu prostopadła do dominującego wiatru niosącego mgłę. Umocuj boki i dodaj odciągi. Dolna krawędź powinna znajdować się nad czystą rynną, bez dotykania ziemi. Nie montuj konstrukcji w miejscu, w którym podmuch mógłby przewrócić ją na ludzi.","check":"Od strony wiatru widać całą szerokość siatki, nie tylko jej krawędź. Słupki muszą stać stabilnie."},{"title":"Zamontuj rynnę ze spadkiem i odprowadź wodę","body":"Pod dolną krawędzią siatki przymocuj czystą rynnę z niewielkim spadkiem w jedną stronę. Od ujścia poprowadź krótki wężyk do zamykanej butelki lub kanistra. Krople powinny spływać po siatce do rynny, a nie po zabrudzonych linkach czy słupkach. Chroń pojemnik przed liśćmi i owadami.","check":"Na próbę polej górę siatki niewielką ilością czystej wody: powinna trafić do pojemnika bez kałuż przy podporach."},{"title":"Sprawdź, czy krople rzeczywiście pochodzą z mgły","body":"Podczas mgły obserwuj, jak drobne krople osiadają na włóknach, łączą się i spływają w dół. Na początku siatka sama nasiąka, więc na odpływ można poczekać. Gdy pada deszcz, woda deszczowa również trafi do zbiornika — nie wliczaj jej do wyniku zbierania mgły.","check":"Woda powinna pojawiać się w rynnie podczas mgły. Mokra siatka nie oznacza jeszcze użytecznej wydajności."},{"title":"Wypróbuj mały improwizowany łapacz","body":"Bez dużej siatki rozepnij czysty kawałek materiału siatkowego między kijkami trekkingowymi lub gałęziami, kierując dolną krawędź do kubka. To tylko próba: mała powierzchnia i niedopasowany materiał często dają znikomy zbiór. Nie poświęcaj na to ostatnich sił ani zapasu wody pitnej.","check":"Siatka nie dotyka gleby, a kubek stoi stabilnie. Jeśli po kilku epizodach mgły zbiór jest bardzo mały, szukaj innego źródła."},{"title":"Mierz wydajność i czyść konstrukcję","body":"Zbieraj wodę w pojemniku z podziałką. Zapisuj objętość, czas, obecność mgły i kierunek wiatru przez kilka epizodów. Po silnym wietrze dociągnij mocowania. Usuwaj z siatki, rynny i rurki liście, pył, glony i odchody. Rzeczywista wydajność mocno zależy od terenu, pory roku, mgły i wiatru.","check":"Siatka jest cała, rynna odprowadza wodę, a woda nie stoi w wężyku."},{"title":"Oceń jakość i uzdatnij zebraną wodę","body":"Woda z mgły może zawierać drobnoustroje, pył, sól morską i zanieczyszczenia z powietrza lub sprzętu. Przelej ją do czystego pojemnika, usuń widoczne zanieczyszczenia i zastosuj odpowiednią dezynfekcję. Przy podejrzeniu emisji przemysłowych, pestycydów lub toksycznych chemikaliów nie używaj jej do picia: gotowanie nie usuwa takich substancji.","check":"Wodę surową i pitną przechowuj w osobnych, oznaczonych pojemnikach. Przejrzystość nie dowodzi bezpieczeństwa."}]}},"diagramLabels":{"fogFlow":"Wiatr z mgłą","mesh":"Siatka","droplets":"Krople","gutter":"Rynna","container":"Pojemnik","good":"Działa lepiej","poor":"Działa słabo","wind":"Mgła + wiatr","dry":"Brak mgły","clean":"Sprawdź jakość wody"}}},"waterEditorialEdition":{"articles":36,"photographicPanelsAdded":78,"expandedSteps":191,"date":"2026-11-23","languageStatus":"75 languages registered; Ukrainian complete; English and Polish interface preview; remaining translation planned"}};</script><script>(() => {
'use strict';
const BASE_D = window.ATLAS_V8;
const D = {...BASE_D};
let activeLang = 'uk';
const REGISTRY = BASE_D.languageRegistry;
if (REGISTRY.length !== 75 || new Set(REGISTRY.map(x=>x.code)).size !== 75) throw Error('The language list must contain exactly 75 unique codes');
const tr = key => (BASE_D.languagePacks[activeLang]?.ui?.[key] || BASE_D.languagePacks.uk.ui[key] || key);
const diagramTr = key => (BASE_D.languagePacks[activeLang]?.diagramLabels?.[key] || BASE_D.languagePacks.uk.diagramLabels[key] || key);
const packFor = code => BASE_D.languagePacks[code] || {};
function applyLanguage(code){
  const item=REGISTRY.find(x=>x.code===code);
  activeLang=(item && item.status!=='planned')?code:'uk';
  const pack=packFor(activeLang);
  D.sections=BASE_D.sections.map(s=>pack.sectionTitles?.[s.id]?{...s,title:pack.sectionTitles[s.id]}:s);
  D.guides=BASE_D.guides.map(g=>{
    const update=pack.guides?.[g.id];
    if(!update)return g;
    const {steps,...fields}=update;
    return {...g,...fields,steps:g.steps.map((st,i)=>({...st,...(steps?.[i]||{})}))};
  });
  D.species=BASE_D.species;
  D.emergency=BASE_D.emergency;
  document.documentElement.lang=activeLang;
  document.documentElement.dir=item?.dir || 'ltr';
}

const root = document.getElementById('app');
const esc = value => String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, ch => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[ch]));
const read = (key,fallback) => {try {return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)) ?? fallback;} catch {return fallback;}};
const write = (key,value) => {try {localStorage.setItem(key,JSON.stringify(value));} catch {}};
applyLanguage(read('atlas-lang','uk'));
let favorites = read('atlas7-fav',[]);
if (!Array.isArray(favorites)) favorites = [];
let query = '';
const byTheme = id => D.sections.find(s=>s.id===id);
const byGuide = id => D.guides.find(g=>g.id===id);
const bySpecies = id => D.species.find(s=>s.id===id);
const oldTopic = id => null; // підтеми видалено повністю
const themeTitle = id => (packFor(activeLang).sectionTitles?.[id]||({nature:'Гриби та ягоди',food:'Риболовля та риба',emergency:'Безпека й небезпеки',rope:'Вузли й спорядження',direction:'Орієнтування'}[id]||byTheme(id)?.title||id));
const themeSubtitle = id => ({nature:'Їстівні й отруйні види, схожі двійники та правила обережності',food:'Снасті, наживки, поведінка риби та визначальні ознаки',emergency:'Що робити в загрозливих ситуаціях',rope:'Кріплення, туристичні вузли та ремонт спорядження'}[id]||byTheme(id)?.desc||'');
const themeIcon = id => ({water:'💧',fire:'🔥',shelter:'⛺',nature:'🍄',food:'🐟',direction:'🧭',rope:'🪢',emergency:'⚠️'}[id]||byTheme(id)?.icon||'◈');
const themeCount = id => D.guides.filter(g=>g.cat===id).length+(id==='nature'?D.species.filter(s=>['mushrooms','berries'].includes(s.group)).length:0)+(id==='food'?D.species.filter(s=>s.group==='fish').length:0)+(id==='emergency'?D.emergency.length:0);
const image = (src,cl='',alt='') => src ? `<img class="${esc(cl)}" src="${esc(src)}" alt="${esc(alt)}" loading="lazy">` : `<div class="image-unavailable" role="img" aria-label="Непідтверджене зображення"><span>Перевіреної фотографії виду немає</span></div>`;
const logo = (large=false) => `<svg class="atlas-logo ${large?'atlas-logo-large':''}" viewBox="0 0 120 120" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Логотип Survival Atlas"><circle cx="60" cy="60" r="56" fill="#13231a" stroke="#d6a45b" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="60" cy="60" r="49" fill="none" stroke="#6c8d69" stroke-width="1.4"/><path d="M60 7 65 23 60 21 55 23Z M60 113 65 97 60 99 55 97Z M7 60 23 55 21 60 23 65Z M113 60 97 55 99 60 97 65Z" fill="#d6a45b"/><circle cx="60" cy="61" r="35" fill="#203629"/><circle cx="82" cy="37" r="9" fill="#e8ad53"/><path d="M19 80 42 47 51 58 70 34 100 78Z" fill="#9eb09c"/><path d="M39 51 42 47 51 58 70 34 85 55 72 47 69 53 64 46 52 69 44 59Z" fill="#f5e8cc"/><path d="M18 82 30 65 42 82 50 69 59 82 71 65 85 82 92 70 103 82V97H17Z" fill="#27543c"/><path d="M28 84v-16m-7 8 7-18 7 18m47 8V67m-8 9 8-20 8 20" stroke="#c5ddae" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" fill="none"/><path d="M25 93H96" stroke="#d6a45b" stroke-width="2"/></svg>`;
const route=()=>{const [page,id]=(location.hash||'#home').slice(1).split('/');return {page:page||'home',id:id||''};};
const go=path=>{if(location.hash==='#'+path) render();else location.hash=path;};
const back=()=>{const r=route();if(['article','species','safety'].includes(r.page)){go('theme/'+(r.page==='article'?byGuide(r.id)?.cat:r.page==='species'?(bySpecies(r.id)?.group==='fish'?'food':'nature'):'emergency'));}else{go('home');}};
const header=(title='Survival Atlas',backBtn=false)=>`<header class="app-header v9-header"><button class="top-icon" data-nav="${backBtn?'back':'home'}" aria-label="${esc(backBtn?tr('back'):tr('home'))}">${backBtn?'‹':logo()}</button><div class="header-title"><span>${esc(tr('guideKicker'))}</span><strong>${esc(title)}</strong></div><button class="top-icon atlas-lang-btn" data-nav="languages" aria-label="${esc(tr('languages'))}" title="${esc(tr('languages'))}">🌐</button><button class="top-icon top-search" data-nav="search" aria-label="${esc(tr('search'))}">⌕</button></header>`;
const bottom=(active)=>`<nav class="bottom-nav v9-bottom" aria-label="${esc(tr('homeMenu'))}">${[['home',tr('home'),'⌂'],['search',tr('search'),'⌕'],['saved',tr('saved'),'☆']].map(([id,title,ico])=>`<button data-nav="${id}" class="nav-item ${active===id?'active':''}" ${active===id?'aria-current="page"':''}><span>${ico}</span><small>${esc(title)}</small></button>`).join('')}</nav>`;
const breadcrumbs=(items)=>`<nav class="crumbs" aria-label="Навігаційний шлях">${[['home',tr('home')],...items].map(([url,label],i)=>`${i?'<span>›</span>':''}${url?`<button data-nav="${esc(url)}">${esc(label)}</button>`:`<b>${esc(label)}</b>`}`).join('')}</nav>`;
const hero=(src,label,title,subtitle,kind)=>`<div class="cover ${kind}">${image(src,'cover-image',title)}<div class="cover-scrim"></div><div class="cover-copy"><small>${esc(label)}</small><h1>${esc(title)}</h1><p>${esc(subtitle)}</p></div></div>`;
const sectionCard=s=>`<button class="menu-card v9-menu-card" data-nav="theme/${s.id}">${image(s.image,'',themeTitle(s.id))}<div class="menu-shade"></div><span class="menu-copy"><em>${themeIcon(s.id)}</em><b>${esc(themeTitle(s.id))}</b><small>${esc(themeCount(s.id))} ${esc(tr('materialsCount'))}</small></span><span class="menu-arrow">›</span></button>`;
const guideCard=g=>`<button class="article-link v9-article-link" data-nav="article/${g.id}"><span class="atlas-number-thumb">${image(g.image,'article-thumb',g.title)}<span class="atlas-guide-number">${String(g.articleNumber||1).padStart(2,'0')}</span></span><span class="article-link-content"><b>${esc(g.title)}</b><small>${esc(g.subtitle)}</small></span><span class="article-link-arrow">›</span></button>`;
const speciesTag=s=>({edible:['Їстівний за надійного визначення','safe'],toxic:['Отруйний','danger'],deadly:['Смертельно небезпечний','danger'],avoid:['Не вживати','warn'],reference:['Риба','neutral']}[s.status]||['Потребує перевірки','warn']);
const speciesCard=s=>{const [label,tone]=speciesTag(s);return `<button class="article-link v9-article-link" data-nav="species/${s.id}">${image(s.image,'article-thumb',s.name)}<span class="article-link-content"><b>${esc(s.name)}</b><small class="latin">${esc(s.latin)}</small><small class="status ${tone}">${esc(label)}</small></span><span class="article-link-arrow">›</span></button>`;};
const safetyCard=(e,i)=>`<button class="article-link v9-safety-link" data-nav="safety/${i}"><span class="risk-mark">!</span><span class="article-link-content"><b>${esc(e.title)}</b><small>${esc(e.intro)}</small></span><span class="article-link-arrow">›</span></button>`;
const note=(body,type='normal')=>`<aside class="note ${type}"><span>${type==='alert'?'!':'i'}</span><p>${esc(body)}</p></aside>`;
const favoriteKey=(type,id)=>type==='article'?id:type+':'+id;
const favButton=(type,id)=>{const k=favoriteKey(type,id);const isSaved=favorites.includes(k);return `<button class="bookmark ${isSaved?'saved':''}" data-save="${esc(k)}">${esc(tr(isSaved?'savedLabel':'save'))}</button>`;};
function home(){const background=D.sections.find(s=>s.id==='direction')?.image||D.sections[0].image;return `${header('Survival Atlas')}<main class="screen home-screen"><section class="v9-home-hero">${image(background,'cover-image','Гори й природа')}<div class="cover-scrim"></div><div class="v9-hero-content">${logo(true)}<div class="v9-brand-name">SURVIVAL <span>ATLAS</span></div><p>${esc(tr('homeIntro'))}</p><span class="v9-offline">${esc(tr('offline'))}</span></div></section><div class="content"><div class="v9-intro-row"><h1 class="section-title" id="theme-menu">${esc(tr('homeMenu'))}</h1><span>${D.sections.length} тем</span></div><p class="section-subtitle">${esc(tr('homeMenuSubtitle'))}</p><div class="menu-grid v9-menu-grid">${D.sections.map(sectionCard).join('')}</div><section class="v9-featured"><div class="quick-heading"><b>${esc(tr('recommended'))}</b></div><div class="link-list">${['aid-bleeding','storm-lightning','city-blackout','boil-correctly'].map(byGuide).filter(Boolean).map(guideCard).join('')}</div></section>${note(tr('photosUnsafe'))}</div></main>${bottom('home')}`;}
function theme(s){const gs=D.guides.filter(g=>g.cat===s.id);const forest=D.species.filter(x=>['mushrooms','berries'].includes(x.group));const fish=D.species.filter(x=>x.group==='fish');let entries='';
if(gs.length)entries+=`<h2 class="section-title v9-list-title">${esc(s.id==='food'?tr('fishingInstructions'):tr('allArticles'))}</h2><div class="link-list">${gs.map(guideCard).join('')}</div>`;
if(s.id==='nature'){entries+=`${note('Навчальні описи: визначати гриби й ягоди для вживання лише за фотографіями небезпечно.','alert')}<h2 class="section-title v9-list-title">${esc(tr('mushrooms'))}</h2><div class="link-list">${forest.filter(x=>x.group==='mushrooms').map(speciesCard).join('')}</div><h2 class="section-title v9-list-title">${esc(tr('berries'))}</h2><div class="link-list">${forest.filter(x=>x.group==='berries').map(speciesCard).join('')}</div>`;}
if(s.id==='food')entries+=`<h2 class="section-title v9-list-title">${esc(tr('fishSpecies'))}</h2><div class="link-list">${fish.map(speciesCard).join('')}</div>`;
if(s.id==='emergency')entries+=`<div class="link-list">${D.emergency.map(safetyCard).join('')}</div>`;
return `${header(themeTitle(s.id),true)}<main class="screen"><div class="v9-theme-hero">${hero(s.image,tr('topic'),themeTitle(s.id),themeSubtitle(s.id),'category-cover')}</div><div class="content">${breadcrumbs([[null,themeTitle(s.id)]])}<div class="v9-theme-count"><span>${themeIcon(s.id)}</span> ${themeCount(s.id)} ${esc(tr('materialsInTopic'))}</div>${entries}</div></main>${bottom('home')}`;}

const waterGlossary = () => activeLang==='pl'?{
path:'Schemat działania',verify:'Trzy kontrole bezpieczeństwa',risk:'Co zrobić, gdy pojawi się ryzyko',step:'Etap',before:'Przed rozpoczęciem',during:'Podczas działania',after:'Przed użyciem',stop:'Nie używaj ryzykownego źródła',finish:'Bezpieczny wynik',sources:'Źródła zaleceń',prev:'Poprzedni artykuł',next:'Następny artykuł',index:'Wszystkie artykuły o wodzie',progress:'Twój plan działania'
}:activeLang==='en'?{
path:'Method map',verify:'Three safety checkpoints',risk:'Risk decision',step:'Stage',before:'Before starting',during:'While working',after:'Before use',stop:'Reject a risky source',finish:'Safe outcome',sources:'Safety references',prev:'Previous article',next:'Next article',index:'All water articles',progress:'Action plan'
}:{
path:'Схема методу',verify:'Три контрольні перевірки',risk:'Що робити за небезпеки',step:'Етап',before:'Перед початком',during:'Під час роботи',after:'Перед використанням',stop:'Відмовся від ризикованого джерела',finish:'Безпечний результат',sources:'Джерела рекомендацій',prev:'Попередня стаття',next:'Наступна стаття',index:'Усі статті про воду',progress:'План дій'
};
function waterVisuals(g){
 if(g.cat!=='water')return '';
 const l=waterGlossary(),st=g.steps||[],n=st.length;
 const indices=[0,Math.max(1,Math.floor(n/2)-1),n-1];
 const tracks=indices.map((j,i)=>`<div class="water-flow-box"><span class="water-flow-num">0${i+1}</span><strong>${esc(st[j].title)}</strong><small>${esc([l.before,l.during,l.after][i])}</small></div>`).join('<span class="water-flow-arrow">›</span>');
 const checks=[st[0],st[Math.max(1,Math.floor(n/2))],st[n-1]].map((step,i)=>`<div class="water-check-card"><span>${['◉','◈','✓'][i]}</span><div><b>${esc([l.before,l.during,l.after][i])}</b><p>${esc(step.check||step.title)}</p></div></div>`).join('');
 return `<section class="article-section water-visual-guide"><h2>${esc(l.path)}</h2><div class="water-flow">${tracks}</div><h2>${esc(l.verify)}</h2><div class="water-check-stack">${checks}</div><h2>${esc(l.risk)}</h2><div class="water-decision"><div class="water-decision-bad"><span>!</span><strong>${esc(l.stop)}</strong><p>${esc(g.safety)}</p></div><div class="water-decision-good"><span>✓</span><strong>${esc(l.finish)}</strong><p>${esc(g.verify)}</p></div></div></section>`;
}
function waterSources(g){if(!g.references?.length)return '';
 const l=waterGlossary();return `<section class="article-section water-sources"><h2>${esc(l.sources)}</h2><p>${activeLang==='uk'?'Висновки щодо обробки води перевірено за офіційними матеріалами. Посилання відкриваються лише за наявності інтернету.':''}</p>${g.references.map(r=>`<a href="${esc(r.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">↗ ${esc(r.name)}</a>`).join('')}</section>`;
}
function waterNavigation(g){if(g.cat!=='water')return '';
 const l=waterGlossary(),W=D.guides.filter(x=>x.cat==='water').sort((a,b)=>a.articleNumber-b.articleNumber),i=W.findIndex(x=>x.id===g.id);
 return `<nav class="water-next-navigation" aria-label="Water article navigation"><button data-nav="${i>0?'article/'+W[i-1].id:'theme/water'}">← ${esc(i>0?l.prev:l.index)}</button><span>${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')} / ${W.length}</span><button data-nav="${i+1<W.length?'article/'+W[i+1].id:'theme/water'}">${esc(i+1<W.length?l.next:l.index)} →</button></nav>`;
}

function article(g){const s=byTheme(g.cat);const isWaterSearch=g.id==='where-search-water';const isSpringStream=g.id==='find-spring-stream';const isSafestSource=g.id==='choose-safest-source';const articleMode=isWaterSearch?'water-search-article':isSpringStream?'spring-stream-article':isSafestSource?'safest-source-article':'';const introHtml=isSpringStream?g.goal.split(/\n\n+/).map(para=>`<p>${esc(para)}</p>`).join(''):`<p>${esc(g.goal)}</p>`;const galleryHeading=g.galleryTitle||(isSafestSource?'Схеми вибору':'Схеми й орієнтири');const galleryIntro=g.galleryIntro?`<p>${esc(g.galleryIntro)}</p>`:(isSafestSource&&g.gallery?.length?`<p>Ці схеми допомагають швидко відсіяти погані варіанти і порівняти кілька джерел ще до набору води.</p>`:'');const gallerySection=g.gallery?.length&&!isWaterSearch?`<section class="article-section"><h2>${esc(galleryHeading)}</h2>${galleryIntro}<div class="water-step-references">${g.gallery.map(item=>`<figure class="atlas-figure water-map-reference">${image(item.image,'step-image',item.title)}</figure>`).join('')}</div></section>`:'';const quickFactsSection=g.quickFacts?.length?`<section class="article-section"><h2>${esc(tr('keyFacts'))}</h2><div class="atlas-quickfacts">${g.quickFacts.map(f=>`<div><span>✓</span>${esc(f)}</div>`).join('')}</div></section>`:'';return `${header(tr('article'),true)}<main class="screen article-screen ${articleMode}">${g.refined?`<section class="atlas-reference-head"><span class="atlas-reference-kicker">${esc(themeTitle(g.cat))} · ${esc(tr('articleNum'))}${String(g.articleNumber||1).padStart(2,'0')}</span><h1>${esc(g.title)}</h1><p>${esc(g.subtitle)}</p></section>`:hero(g.image,tr('articleNum')+String(g.articleNumber||1).padStart(2,'0'),g.title,g.subtitle,'article-cover')}<div class="content article-content">${breadcrumbs([['theme/'+s.id,themeTitle(s.id)],[null,g.title]])}<div class="article-toolbar">${favButton('article',g.id)}</div>${activeLang!=='uk'&&!packFor(activeLang).guides?.[g.id]?`<p class="atlas-untranslated" lang="uk">${esc(tr('articleAvailableUA'))}</p>`:''}<section class="article-section"><h2>${esc(tr('description'))}</h2>${introHtml}</section>${g.refined?`<figure class="atlas-full-diagram">${image(g.image,'full-diagram',g.title)}</figure>`:''}${gallerySection}${quickFactsSection}<section class="article-section"><h2>${esc(tr('needed'))}</h2><ul class="materials-list">${g.materials.map(m=>`<li>${esc(m)}</li>`).join('')}</ul>${g.alternate?`<p class="muted-box"><b>${esc(tr('alternative'))}:</b> ${esc(g.alternate)}</p>`:''}</section>${g.comparison?.length?`<section class="article-section"><h2>${esc(tr('comparison'))}</h2><div class="atlas-table-scroll"><table class="atlas-ref-table"><tbody>${g.comparison.map((row,i)=>`<tr>${(Array.isArray(row)?row:[row.label||'',row.value||'']).map((cell,j)=>`<${j===0?'th':'td'}>${esc(cell)}</${j===0?'th':'td'}>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div></section>`:''}<section class="article-section"><h2>${esc(tr('steps'))}</h2>${g.steps.map((step,i)=>`<section class="readable-step"><div class="step-heading"><span>${i+1}</span><h3>${esc(step.title)}</h3></div>${step.photo?`<figure class="atlas-figure ${step.photoKind==='storyboard'?'atlas-photo-sequence':''}">${isWaterSearch?image(step.photo,'step-image',step.title).replace('loading="lazy"','loading="eager"'):image(step.photo,'step-image',step.title)}</figure>`:''}${isWaterSearch&&g.gallery?.length&&(i===0||i===1)?`<div class="water-step-references">${(i===0?g.gallery.slice(0,2):g.gallery.slice(2,3)).map(item=>`<figure class="atlas-figure water-map-reference">${image(item.image,'step-image',item.title)}</figure>`).join('')}</div>`:''}${isSpringStream?step.body.split(/\n\n+/).map(para=>`<p>${esc(para)}</p>`).join(''):`<p>${esc(step.body)}</p>`}${step.check?`<div class="step-observation"><b>${esc(tr('check'))}</b><p>${esc(step.check)}</p></div>`:''}${g.stepSchemes?.length?g.stepSchemes.filter(item=>item.after===i).map(diagramImage).join(''):''}</section>`).join('')}</section>${waterVisuals(g)}<section class="article-section"><h2>${esc(tr('result'))}</h2><p>${esc(g.verify)}</p></section><section class="article-section"><h2>${esc(tr('mistakes'))}</h2><p>${esc(g.mistake)}</p></section>${note(g.safety,'alert')}${waterSources(g)}${waterNavigation(g)}<div class="article-end"><button data-nav="theme/${s.id}">← ${esc(tr('backToArticles'))} «${esc(themeTitle(s.id))}»</button></div></div></main>${bottom('home')}`;}
function species(s){const th=s.group==='fish'?'food':'nature';const [label,tone]=speciesTag(s);return `${header('Довідкова стаття',true)}<main class="screen article-screen">${hero(s.image,'ДОВІДНИК ПРИРОДИ',s.name,s.latin,'species-cover')}<div class="content article-content">${breadcrumbs([['theme/'+th,themeTitle(th)],[null,s.name]])}<div class="article-toolbar"><span class="status ${tone}">${esc(label)}</span>${favButton('species',s.id)}</div>${note(s.group==='fish'?'Місцеві правила риболовлі, дозволені види й сезони можуть відрізнятися.':'Фото — ілюстрація, а не надійний спосіб встановити вид. Ніколи не їжте гриби чи ягоди без достовірного визначення.',s.group==='fish'?'normal':'alert')}<section class="article-section"><h2>Основні ознаки</h2><ul class="materials-list">${s.traits.map(t=>`<li>${esc(t)}</li>`).join('')}</ul></section><section class="article-section"><h2>${s.group==='fish'?'Особливості та обмеження':'Схожі види та двійники'}</h2><p>${esc(s.lookalike)}</p></section><section class="article-section"><h2>Де і коли трапляється</h2><p>${esc(s.season)}</p></section>${note(s.note,'alert')}<div class="article-end"><button data-nav="theme/${th}">← Повернутися до теми</button></div></div></main>${bottom('home')}`;}
function safety(e,i){return `${header('Стаття з безпеки',true)}<main class="screen content page-screen">${breadcrumbs([['theme/emergency',themeTitle('emergency')],[null,e.title]])}<div class="kicker">НЕВІДКЛАДНІ ДІЇ</div><h1 class="page-title">${esc(e.title)}</h1><p class="intro">${esc(e.intro)}</p><div class="article-toolbar"><span>Інформаційна пам’ятка</span>${favButton('safety',i)}</div>${note('За безпосередньої небезпеки життю викличте місцеві екстрені служби.','alert')}<section class="article-section"><h2>Що робити</h2><ol class="safety-list">${e.action.map(t=>`<li>${esc(t)}</li>`).join('')}</ol></section>${note(e.warning,'alert')}<div class="article-end"><button data-nav="theme/emergency">← Інші статті з безпеки</button></div></main>${bottom('home')}`;}
function saved(){const cards=favorites.map(k=>{if(k.startsWith('species:')){const s=bySpecies(k.slice(8));return s?speciesCard(s):'';}if(k.startsWith('safety:')){const n=Number(k.slice(7));return D.emergency[n]?safetyCard(D.emergency[n],n):'';}const g=byGuide(k);return g?guideCard(g):'';}).filter(Boolean);return `${header(tr('saved'),true)}<main class="screen content page-screen">${breadcrumbs([[null,'Обране']])}<div class="kicker">ВАШІ МАТЕРІАЛИ</div><h1 class="page-title">${esc(tr('savedTitle'))}</h1><p class="intro">Улюблені матеріали доступні офлайн.</p><div class="link-list">${cards.length?cards.join(''):'<div class="empty">Тут поки немає статей. На сторінці матеріалу натисніть «Зберегти».</div>'}</div></main>${bottom('saved')}`;}
function searchPage(){return `${header(tr('search'),true)}<main class="screen content page-screen">${breadcrumbs([[null,'Пошук']])}<div class="kicker">ШВИДКИЙ ПОШУК</div><h1 class="page-title">${esc(tr('searchTitle'))}</h1><label class="searchbox"><span>⌕</span><input id="searchInput" type="search" value="${esc(query)}" placeholder="${esc(tr('searchPlaceholder'))}" autocomplete="off"></label><div id="results"></div></main>${bottom('search')}`;}
function searchResults(){const q=query.toLocaleLowerCase(activeLang).trim();if(!q)return `<p class="search-hint">${esc(tr('searchHint'))}</p>`;const a=D.guides.filter(g=>[g.title,g.subtitle,g.goal,...g.materials,...g.steps.map(st=>st.title+' '+st.body)].join(' ').toLocaleLowerCase(activeLang).includes(q));const b=D.species.filter(s=>[s.name,s.latin,s.lookalike,s.season,...s.traits].join(' ').toLocaleLowerCase(activeLang).includes(q));const c=D.emergency.map((e,i)=>({...e,i})).filter(e=>[e.title,e.intro,...e.action].join(' ').toLocaleLowerCase(activeLang).includes(q));return `${a.length?`<h2 class="section-title">Статті (${a.length})</h2><div class="link-list">${a.map(guideCard).join('')}</div>`:''}${b.length?`<h2 class="section-title">Довідник природи (${b.length})</h2><div class="link-list">${b.map(speciesCard).join('')}</div>`:''}${c.length?`<h2 class="section-title">Безпека (${c.length})</h2><div class="link-list">${c.map(e=>safetyCard(e,e.i)).join('')}</div>`:''}${a.length+b.length+c.length?'':`<p class="empty">${esc(tr('nothingFound'))}</p>`}`;}

function languageList(query=''){
  const q=query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
  const rows=REGISTRY.filter(x=>!q||x.name.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(q)||x.code.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(q));
  return rows.length?rows.map(x=>{
    const disabled=x.status==='planned';
    const status=x.status==='ready'?tr('languageReady'):x.status==='preview'?tr('languagePreview'):tr('languagePlanned');
    return `<button class="atlas-language-row ${disabled?'is-pending':''} ${x.code===activeLang?'is-current':''}" ${disabled?'disabled':''} data-choose-language="${esc(x.code)}" aria-label="${esc(x.name+' — '+status)}"><span class="atlas-language-name">${esc(x.name)}<small>${esc(x.code)}</small></span><span class="atlas-language-status">${esc(status)}</span></button>`;
  }).join(''):`<p class="atlas-empty">${esc(tr('languageFilterEmpty'))}</p>`;
}
function languagesPage(){
  return `${header(tr('languageTitle'),true)}<main class="screen content page-screen atlas-languages-screen">${breadcrumbs([[null,tr('languages')]])}<h1 class="page-title">${esc(tr('languageTitle'))}</h1><p class="intro">${esc(tr('languageSubtitle'))}</p><div class="atlas-languages-summary">${esc(tr('languageTotal'))}</div>${activeLang!=='uk'?`<p class="atlas-translation-warning">${esc(tr('languagePreviewInfo'))}</p>`:''}<label class="searchbox"><span>⌕</span><input id="languageFilter" type="search" placeholder="${esc(tr('languageSearch'))}" autocomplete="off"></label><div id="languageResults">${languageList()}</div><p class="atlas-languages-footnote">${esc(tr('languageOffline'))}</p></main>${bottom('home')}`;
}
const translationNotice = () => activeLang==='uk'?'':`<div class="atlas-translation-notice">🌐 ${esc(tr('languagePreviewInfo'))}</div>`;
function diagramImage(item){
  if(!item.i18n)return `<figure class="atlas-figure atlas-instruction-diagram">${image(item.image,'step-image',item.title)}</figure>`;
  const labels=(item.labels||[]).map(p=>`<span class="atlas-visual-label" style="left:${Number(p.x)}%;top:${Number(p.y)}%">${esc(diagramTr(p.key))}</span>`).join('');
  return `<figure class="atlas-figure atlas-instruction-diagram atlas-translatable-diagram"><div class="atlas-diagram-canvas">${image(item.image,'step-image',item.title)}${labels}</div></figure>`;
}
function render(){const r=route();const s=byTheme(r.id);let html;
switch(r.page){case 'home':case 'sections':html=home();break;case 'theme':case 'section':html=s?theme(s):home();break;case 'topic':html=home();break;case 'article':html=byGuide(r.id)?article(byGuide(r.id)):home();break;case 'species':html=bySpecies(r.id)?species(bySpecies(r.id)):home();break;case 'safety':html=D.emergency[Number(r.id)]?safety(D.emergency[Number(r.id)],Number(r.id)):home();break;case 'saved':html=saved();break;case 'languages':html=languagesPage();break;case 'search':html=searchPage();break;case 'nature':html=theme(byTheme('nature'));break;default:html=home();}
root.innerHTML=translationNotice()+html;if(r.page==='search'){document.getElementById('results').innerHTML=searchResults();}
window.scrollTo(0,0);document.title='Survival Atlas — '+(r.page==='article'?(byGuide(r.id)?.title||'Стаття'):r.page==='theme'?themeTitle(r.id):tr('guideKicker'));}
window.addEventListener('hashchange',render);
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b)return;if(b.dataset.diagram){const g=byGuide(b.dataset.diagram);if(!g)return;const src=b.dataset.variant==='gallery'?g.gallery?.[Number(b.dataset.gallery)]?.image:b.dataset.variant==='detail'?g.steps[Number(b.dataset.step)]?.photo:g.image;if(!src)return;const overlay=document.createElement('div');overlay.className='atlas-zoom-overlay';overlay.setAttribute('role','dialog');overlay.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="atlas-zoom-bar"><strong>${esc(g.title)}</strong><button class="atlas-zoom-close" aria-label="Закрити ілюстрацію">✕</button></div><div class="atlas-zoom-scroll"><img src="${esc(src)}" alt="${esc(g.title)}" /></div><p>Переглядай ілюстрацію • Торкнись ✕, щоб повернутися</p>`;document.body.appendChild(overlay);overlay.querySelector('.atlas-zoom-close').onclick=()=>overlay.remove();overlay.addEventListener('click',ev=>{if(ev.target===overlay)overlay.remove()});return;}if(b.dataset.chooseLanguage){applyLanguage(b.dataset.chooseLanguage);write('atlas-lang',activeLang);render();return;}if(b.dataset.nav){if(b.dataset.nav==='back')back();else go(b.dataset.nav);return;}if(b.dataset.save){const k=b.dataset.save;favorites=favorites.includes(k)?favorites.filter(x=>x!==k):[...favorites,k];write('atlas7-fav',favorites);render();return;}});
document.addEventListener('input',e=>{if(e.target?.id==='languageFilter'){document.getElementById('languageResults').innerHTML=languageList(e.target.value);}if(e.target?.id==='searchInput'){query=e.target.value;document.getElementById('results').innerHTML=searchResults();}});
if(!location.hash)location.hash='home';else render();
})();
</script></body></html>
